descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you detail oriented, even when multitasking? Do you want to get experience in the Asset Management business?
We're looking for someone like that to help us with:
- daily dividend events processing,
- dividend and interest payments review,
- processing of account charges and FX transactions,
- reconciliation of the booked transactions,
- interaction with various stakeholders worldwide.
Your paid internship will last up to 12 months working 40 hours/week, with a possibility of extension.
